question: Does rainfall-associated 0-to-CallingIndex-2/3 recruitment persist when observer identity and physical stop identity are simultaneously held constant?
sample: Intersection of the existing same-observer pair set and pairs with all ten nonmissing identical SiteID values between wet and dry runs.
response: strong_new_score = sum wet CallingIndex for species x stop cells with dry=0 and wet in {2,3}; strong_new_count = number of such cells.
model: Existing matched-pair model: response ~ rain_contrast + temperature_difference + day_of_year_difference + year_gap + State + RunNumber, cluster-robust by route.
pass_rule: Strong recruitment robustness passes if both strong_new_score and strong_new_count have positive rain_contrast coefficients with complete 95% CIs >0.
interpretation: A pass makes simple observer turnover, stop relocation, and weak-call-only detection explanations jointly insufficient. It does not eliminate all detectability or identify hydration/hydrology.
